privacy.title: Privacy Policy – Fluxora
privacy.description: Fluxora Privacy Policy. We do not store your data.
privacy.content:
Privacy Policy

Last updated: 2025

We respect your privacy. Here is how we handle your data:

1. Data Processing

Fluxora operates primarily as a client-side application. This means image conversions, text processing, and other calculations happen on your device (in your browser). We do not upload your files to our servers.

2. Analytics

We use anonymous analytics to track simple usage metrics (like 'Page Views') to improve the site. No personal identifiable information (PII) is collected.

3. Cookies

We use local storage to remember your preferences (like theme or language). We do not use tracking cookies for advertising.
